tool_input.command:
R=/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx; python3 - <<PY
import json,hashlib
R="$R"
r=json.load(open(R+"/eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json"))
bad=[k for k,v in r["artifact_snapshot"]["artifacts"].items() if hashlib.sha256(open(R+"/"+k,"rb").read()).hexdigest()!=v]
print("snapshot mismatches",bad)
print(json.dumps({k:r[k] for k in ["evaluator","audit_delegations","gate_results","gaps"]},ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)[:5000])
print([ (a.get("id") or a.get("aspect"), a.get("status") or a.get("verdict")) for a in r["aspects"]] if isinstance(r["aspects"],list) else r["aspects"].keys())
PY
head -c 1500 $R/eval-log/hearing-audit.json; ls -R $R/eval-log/system-spec-harness
